evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing automatic AD systems largely treat generation as a local video-to-text problem, assuming that the content to describe and its temporal location are already provided.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: When evaluated on REFRAMED, a benchmark for realistic AD of movies, our approach makes better decisions than prompted LLMs about what to describe and when to describe it, establishing a new SOTA on narrative QA and temporally grounded metrics.
